API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APISegment Group ManagementGets all configured Segment Groups for the specified customer.
Gets all configured Segment Groups for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/segmentGroup

Gets all configured Segment Groups for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
skipDetailedAppInfo
boolean

Indicates whether to include complete application details or not.

Default value: false
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

400
401
403
404
405
409
415

OK
